WELCOME_STEP.HIGHLIGHT_1_DESC: Collections are plain files on your disk. No cloud sync, no proprietary lock-in.
WELCOME_STEP.HIGHLIGHT_2_DESC: Every request is a readable file. Commit, branch, review, and collaborate using the tools you already know.
WELCOME_STEP.HIGHLIGHT_3_DESC: No account, no login. Bruno works entirely offline, your API keys never leave your machine.
WELCOME_STEP.HIGHLIGHT_4_DESC: Built to be snappy. No bloated runtimes, just a fast, focused tool for exploring and testing APIs.

AI.FEATURES_SUMMARY: Turn on to configure providers and models. Your keys stay local.
AI.EMPTY_CONFIG: Bring your own API key. Bruno talks to providers directly, your keys never leave your machine.
AI.COMPAT_EMPTY: Point Bruno at any OpenAI-compatible API — Ollama, LM Studio, Together, Groq, OpenRouter, vLLM, and more.
AI.AUTOCOMPLETE_EMPTY: Turn on AI in the Configuration tab to use autocomplete.
AI.AUTOCOMPLETE_NO_PROVIDER: Add a provider API key in the Configuration tab to enable autocomplete.
AI.AUTOCOMPLETE_NO_MODEL: No models are available. Enable a model on its provider card in Configuration.
AI.AUTOCOMPLETE_SUB: Ghost-text suggestions in Pre-Request, Post-Response, and Tests scripts
AI.AUTOCOMPLETE_MODEL_RECOMMEND: Lightweight models are recommended for speed
AI.SECURITY_EMPTY: Turn on AI in the Configuration tab to configure redaction.
AI.SECURITY_NOTICE: Sensitive data is automatically redacted before context is sent to AI providers. Turn off protections if needed, or add custom headers and variables to redact.
AI.SECURITY_REDACT_HEADERS_SUB: Masks Authorization, cookies, API keys and other credential-bearing headers in the request context.
AI.SECURITY_REDACT_BODY_SUB: Masks values under keys like password, *_token, secret in JSON and GraphQL variables. Structure and non-sensitive fields still pass through.
AI.SECURITY_REDACT_RESPONSE_SUB: Sends the response as a shape only — real values replaced with type placeholders (<string>, <number>). Turn off to send the actual response body.
AI.SECURITY_REDACT_VARIABLES_SUB: Masks values whose names look like secrets. Variables explicitly marked secret are always redacted regardless of this switch.
AI.SECURITY_CUSTOM_HEADERS_SUB: Exact, case-insensitive header names to always mask on top of the built-in list.
AI.SECURITY_CUSTOM_VARS_SUB: Variable names whose values should always be masked when Bruno lists them for the model — for anything you want redacted besides values already flagged as secret.
AI.SECURITY_COVERED_MORE: plus any name matching token, secret, password or api_key.
AI.SECURITY_LIMIT: Reached the 200-entry limit. Remove one to add another.
AI.PROVIDER_ADD_KEY_PROMPT: Add an API key to enable
AI.COMPAT_SET_BASE_URL_PROMPT: Set a Base URL to enable
AI.COMPAT_NO_MODELS: No models yet. Add the model id your provider expects (e.g. gpt-4o or llama3.1:8b).
